description: This source file implements a DVB tuner interface for Linux using the V4L API. It includes classes and methods for tuning, filtering, and managing DVB frontends, with support for different DVB standards and configurations. The code also handles resource management, status monitoring, and external DVB device interactions.

classes.name: Tuner
classes.description: Represents a DVB tuner device, managing tuning, status, and filtering operations, including resource and thread management.

classes.name: Tuner::Information
classes.description: Singleton class holding tuner configuration, supported standards, and capabilities.

classes.name: Tuner::MuxFilter
classes.description: Handles filtering of MPEG sections from DVB streams via Linux DVB demux device.

classes.name: Tuner::Observer
classes.description: Background thread class monitoring frontend status changes.

methods.name: Tuner::Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a Tuner object based on configuration string.

methods.name: Tuner::Tune
methods.description: Configures the tuner hardware to lock onto a specific frequency, modulation, symbol rate, FEC, and inversion.

methods.name: Tuner::Filter
methods.description: Sets up a filter for specific PID and table ID, with callback for section data.

methods.name: Tuner::Dispatch
methods.description: Checks frontend status and updates internal state, handling lock and timeout events.
